verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the v3 agent docs, which say you can customize the agent by specifying the LLM provider and model. That suggests some provider choice, but it is a single thin mention scoped to the v3 `agent` primitive, and nothing confirms model-agnosticism for v4's act/extract/observe. missing for 10: list of supported providers/models, v4 model-configuration docs, evidence of bringing your own API key or custom/self-hosted model endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration of non-default provider use.
